TS0400001.message: No observation is available for pipeline {pipeline}.
TS0400001.solution: Check the pipeline id for typos; a freshly started pipeline may take a moment to publish its first observation.

TS0400002.solution: Start a new history query, then repeat every query parameter unchanged when following its next cursor.

TS0400003.solution: Start a new history query; cursors are intentionally short-lived and do not hold a server-side session.

TS0400004.message: The {operation} query exceeded the {budget} budget of {limit}.
TS0400004.solution: Narrow the time range or select fewer table series, then start a new query.
